# Business banner screenshots

Retrieved on 2026-10-13 from the projects' official public pages. These files are unmodified marketing screenshots containing public demonstration data, not customer records and not generated interfaces.

## EspoCRM

- File: `espo-crm.png`, 940 × 738 pixels, 192,145 bytes.
- Official source page: https://www.espocrm.com/download/
- Original image: https://www.espocrm.com/wp-content/uploads/EspoCRM-Interface.png
- Description: EspoCRM dashboard with a sales funnel, leads, opportunities and calendar.
- Suggested presentation: preserve the upper-left navigation, main metrics and sales funnel. Use the full image where possible; a lower/right crop is possible for the decorative banner.
- Attribution: EspoCRM. The screenshot is published on EspoCRM's official self-hosted download page. It illustrates the product; the UI and data are unchanged. Product features available in a deployment depend on the installed edition and extensions.

## Nextcloud Files

- File: `nextcloud-files.png`, 1750 × 1000 pixels, 650,470 bytes.
- Official source repository: https://github.com/nextcloud/screenshots
- Original file page: https://github.com/nextcloud/screenshots/blob/master/nextcloud-hub-25-files.png
- Original image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/screenshots/master/nextcloud-hub-25-files.png
- Description: official Nextcloud Hub Files screenshot, showing shared files, access controls and a mobile photo view in a transparent browser-and-phone composition.
- Suggested presentation: show the entire image with `object-fit: contain` to preserve the transparent outline and phone; avoid cutting the existing browser frame.
- Attribution: Nextcloud contributors, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Original pixels are unchanged; the site only scales and positions the image. The license text is included as `LICENSE-nextcloud-screenshots.txt`.
- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
